title: My child is uncomfortable in crowded places. Can Occupational Therapy assist?
metaTitle: Crowded Places and Autism - Guidance through Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network's occupational therapy can help your child with autism become comfortable in crowded places.
html: Of course, dealing with crowded and sensory-rich environments can be challenging for children with autism. Our Occupational therapists can aid your child by utilizing strategies such as sensory integration, deep pressure techniques, and social stories. They work on helping your child become less sensitive and more accepting of their surroundings, gradually making crowded environments less overwhelming.
